heroKicker: Af-Finnishka loogu talagalay YKI, shaqada iyo nolol maalmeedka
heroTitleB: U diyaar garow shaqo ka qabashada Finland.
heroLead: Ku dhis af-Finnish wax-ku-ool ah adigoo ku tababaranaya hadalka, helaya jawaab-celin waxtar leh iyo hagitaan af aad hore u fahanto.
android: Waxa kale oo laga heli karaa Android
transition: KieliValmis waa magaca cusub ee adeegga Floently Finnish ee isticmaalayaashu arkaan. Akoonkaaga, horumarkaaga iyo rukumashadaadu waxay ku sii socdaan isla adeegga.
pathKicker: Hal waddo waxbarasho oo isku xiran
pathTitle: Baro af-Finnishka aad u baahan tahay tallaabada xigta.
pathBody: U diyaar garowga imtixaanka, isgaarsiinta goobta shaqada iyo af-Finnishka maalinlaha ahi waxay ka wada tirsan yihiin hal safar waxbarasho.
card1Body: Ku tababar hadalka, qorista, akhriska iyo dhageysiga hawlo dhab u eg oo la mid ah kuwa YKI.
card2Body: Ku tababar wada-hadallada, su’aalaha iyo sharaxaadaha aad uga baahan tahay xaaladaha shaqo ee dhabta ah.
card3Body: Tababarka af-Finnishku af-Finnish ayuu ahaanayaa. Hagitaanka iyo jawaab-celinta waxaa lagu muujin karaa afka aad doorato.
ykiTitle: Tababar YKI oo isku xira xirfadaha.
ykiBody: Ku tababar isgaarsiinta, dib u eeg jawaab-celinta oo mar kale isku day dhammaan afarta qaybood ee imtixaanka.
workTitle: Af-Finnish loogu talagalay xaaladaha dhab ahaan ka dhaca shaqada.
workBody: Kobci eray-bixinta, naxwaha iyo ku hadalka adigoo adeegsanaya xaalado xirfadeed oo dhab u eg.
langKicker: Afkaaga ayaa kaa caawin kara barashada af-Finnishka
langBody: Dooro afka aad sida ugu fiican u fahanto si aad ugu hesho hagitaanka is-dhexgalka, sharaxaadaha iyo jawaab-celinta.
langNote: Imtixaanka YKI laftiisa waxaa lagu qaadaa af-Finnish ama af-Iswiidhish sida ay dhigayaan xeerarka rasmiga ah. KieliValmis ma sheeganayso in imtixaanka YKI lagu bixiyo 20 luqadood.
finalBody: U diyaar garow YKI, shaqada iyo af-Finnishka maalinlaha ah adigoo adeegsanaya hal khibrad waxbarasho oo isku xiran.
